title: SessionQuota
description: How much a work session may spend in a day. Its own record rather than fields on the session, because the limits are set by whoever runs the system and the session is written by whoever uses it.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The work session the limits apply to, as the system that owns the session names it. One quota per session.

person.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever owns the quota. Carried so the holder of a session id is not by itself the person allowed to change the limits; absent for a session nobody has signed in for.
